mapper.select: select s.item_value as "value", s.item_text as "text" from ins_dict_item s where dict_id = (select id from ins_dict where dict_code = #{code}) order by s.sort_order asc
select s.item_value as "value", s.item_key as "text" from ins_dict_item s where dict_id = (select id from ins_dict where dict_code = #{code}) order by s.sort_order asc
select s.item_text from ins_dict_item s where s.dict_id = (select id from ins_dict where dict_code = #{code}) and s.item_value = #{key}
select ${text} as "text", ${code} as "value" from ${table}

select ${text} as "text",${code} as "value" from ${table}
where ${filterSql}

select ${text} as "text", ${code} as "value" from ${table} where ${code} in
#{key}
select id as "value", depart_name as "text" from ins_depart where del_flag = '0'
select username as "value", realname as "text" from ins_user where del_flag = '0'
select idi.item_text as text, idi.item_value as value from ins_dict_item idi right join ins_dict i on i.id = idi.dict_id where i.dict_code = #{code} order by idi.sort_order

select l.item_text as typeName, l.item_value as typeCode, idi.item_value as classifyCode, case when idi.item_key is not null then idi.item_text end as classifyName from ins_dict_item idi right join (select idi.id, idi.item_text, idi.item_value, idi.sort_order from ins_dict i left join ins_dict_item idi on i.id = idi.dict_id where dict_code = #{energyType}) l on l.id = idi.dict_id order by l.sort_order, idi.sort_order asc

select l.item_text as carType, idi.item_text as carLevel from ins_dict_item idi right join ( select idi.item_text, idi.id, idi.sort_order from ins_dict i left join ins_dict_item idi on i.id = idi.dict_id where dict_code = 'car_type' order by idi.sort_order ) l on l.id = idi.dict_id
order by l.sort_order,idi.sort_order asc
select idi.id, idi.item_text, idi.item_value, idi.sort_order from ins_dict i left join ins_dict_item idi on i.id = idi.dict_id where dict_code = #{dictType} order by idi.sort_order asc

select di.dict_name as typeName, di.dict_code as typeCode, idi.item_value as classifyCode, idi.item_text as classifyName from ins_dict di right join (select idi.item_value from ins_dict di left join ins_dict_item idi on di.id = idi.dict_id where dict_code = #{dictType}) a on di.dict_code = a.item_value left join ins_dict_item idi on di.id = idi.dict_id order by idi.sort_order asc

select sdi.item_text as classifyName,sdi.item_value as classifyCode,sd.dict_code as typeCode from ins_dict sd left join ins_dict_item sdi on sdi.dict_id = sd.id where sd.dict_code = 'competitive_type' union all select sdi.item_text as classifyName,sdi.item_value as classifyCode,sd.dict_code as typeCode from ins_dict sd left join ins_dict_item sdi on sdi.dict_id = sd.id where sd.dict_code = 'is_core' union all select sdi.item_text as classifyName,sdi.item_value as classifyCode,sd.dict_code as typeCode from ins_dict sd left join ins_dict_item sdi on sdi.dict_id = sd.id where sd.dict_code = 'enable_type' union all select sdi.item_text as classifyName,sdi.item_value as classifyCode,sd.dict_code as typeCode from ins_dict sd left join ins_dict_item sdi on sdi.dict_id = sd.id where sd.dict_code = 'is_new_car'
